title: amsinckia menziesii var. intermedia
intro: Amsinckia menziesii var. intermedia, commonly known as Western Lomatium or Fernleaf Lomatium, is a plant species native to the western United States and southwestern Canada. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include immune system support and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Western Lomatium include antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal activities, making it useful in the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of Western Lomatium include sesquiterpenes and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
